title: Escalator Ko Pehle Se Pata Hai Aap Aa Rahe Ho #shorts
description:
Escalator ko pata hai aap aa rahe ho, par kaise? Ek 20 rupaye ka IR sensor yahi kaam karta hai.
🤖 FC-51 IR sensor ka 3D explode view
💡 940 nm IR LED aur photodiode ka kaam
🧠 LM393 comparator aur blue pot ki range
🔌 Arduino wiring: VCC 5V, OUT D2
Aise aur videos ke liye subscribe karo.
